title: Prove the exact Schur rank–dimension law over every field (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Resolves both open questions in #6031: the sharp minimum ambient dimension at every Schur-commutator rank holds over every field and every positive block size, and the forced minimum rank has a closed formula using only d-by-d matrices. The eight-file package is `research/schur-ranks-all-fields/`; predecessors and shared files are unchanged.

For invertible A,B and arbitrary H, put F=A-H, J=B-H and T00=I-A-B+H. For commuting idempotents with prescribed leading blocks A,B,(PQ)11=H, and Schur complements S,Z:

```
n0   = rank T00 + rank F + rank J + rank H
nmax = 3d + rank T00 + nullity F + nullity J + nullity H
rho0 = rank(J A^-1 F) + rank(F B^-1 J) + 2 rank H - 2d
n_min(rho) = max(n0 + rho - rho0, nmax - 2(2d-rho))
```

Every integer rho in [rho0,2d] occurs exactly at dimensions n >= n_min(rho). Here nmax is the least dimension attaining rank 2d, not a maximum ambient dimension. The proof identifies two independent cross-sector pairing blocks; sector-preserving rank cores and radicals attain the lower bound over any field. A ternary example has rho0=1 and dimension profile 5,6,7,9, showing why the binary d=2 evenness pattern does not generalize.

This is a written algebraic proof with bounded computational corroboration, relying explicitly on the credited predecessor factorization and sector-realization results. It is not proof-kernel or independent human acceptance. No new kappa, physical supplier, signed invoice, or selected-record assumption discharge is claimed. Production, consumption, restoration, precision, stock, compiler and outer costs remain unpriced.

## Task and overlap

Canonical base: `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`, priority revision 8, selected conditional kappa=0.003125804. The original `formal-interface-lemma` card is retained verbatim in TASK.json with scope explicitly **changed** to this released algebraic side question, not formalization or a selected-assumption proof. Exact rank/dimension feasibility is useful before pricing a concrete caller.

Handoff-first intake followed the released #6031 questions in [discussion #1166](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19230733). [Canonical progress update](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19232628). Targeted all-state Schur/#6031 searches and recent board claims found no later extension; coverage is not a historical census. Immediate follow-ups to our #5672 were already covered by #5683/#5689/#5692/#5712. README records the five-point family-expansion decision and stop rule.

Exact predecessors:
- Nick Petalas #6031 at `acc000f4edfa0b0c4a90b505c6e02a4c3572f74c`: lower bound, sector-subspace cost reduction and equality at d=2 over F2. This submission proves equality in all dimensions over every field and supplies the requested closed rho0 formula.
- Krzysztof Wojt #5128 at `2839d35e58b3285a1992a3ecbae2809ebef7661b`: arbitrary-pivot maximal-rank theorem and realization.

SOURCES.json binds exact predecessor bytes as provenance; VERIFY.json has no external live inputs.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.14, macOS arm64, standard library only. All package checks passed at commit `12385ca23315181e3d15eb23a2d9ffec65d9a909`:

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/schur-ranks-all-fields/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/schur-ranks-all-fields/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/schur-ranks-all-fields
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/schur-ranks-all-fields --check-source-history
python3.12 -B scripts/export_research_package.py export --package research/schur-ranks-all-fields --ref HEAD --output /tmp/schur-ranks-all-fields.tar
python3.12 -B scripts/export_research_package.py check --check-inputs /tmp/schur-ranks-all-fields.tar
```

The official export also passed normal/optimized replay in a read-only extraction without a Git checkout or Git on PATH; payload bytes and modes remained unchanged. The selected-baseline source-binding check passed; it is not a scientific frontier replay.

Coverage: **886 triples, 303,878 admissible subspace pairs, 3,516 literal witnesses**. Exhaustive d=1 over F2/F3/F5 and all 576 binary d=2 triples; fixed samples of 192 ternary d=2 and 24 binary d=3 triples. The direct subspace oracle does not use the proposed minimum formula; it shares only exact arithmetic with the formula checker. Literal witnesses recheck idempotence, commutation, prescribed blocks and Schur rank. Eight controls reject omitted/equated cross blocks, forced evenness, a wrong minimum, corrupted witness, wrong product block, slope-one-only law and reordered products. Coverage inventories and expected result digest are checked:

`c38f9ced06db3ecf1bc4c7f8802df7f1b3228f3435946700e7340b115d3156db`

**Known base CI issue:** the unchanged base fails two of six `test_research_current_status.py` tests: docs/ci.md still identifies the earlier frontier command, and the current-status decimal is bolded together with its rational expansion. #6050 already addresses both. This package does not duplicate that shared-document fix. No full selected-construction replay, Lean build or Docker replay was run; none is implicated by these isolated files. Hosted CI is reported separately.

Two independent AI-assisted derivations are not independent human review.

## Open next questions

README and TASK.json ask whether an actual decoder/header caller can use this sharp frontier with a favorable complete physical bill. First specify exact A,B,H, target rank, allowed sector dimensions and all charged production/consumption/restoration operations. The missing caller and complete cost contract are the blockers; no further algebraic construction round is justified without them.
